caption: The plan page of the app SB: FAQ | HelpCenter in the Shopify admin, monthly view (the toggle Monthly selected, next to Annual (save 2 months)): Standard $40/month with 14-Day Free Trial, Knowledge Base: 100 Articles, FAQ translations up to 5, FAQ templates, AI-generated FAQs, Unlimited seats and CRM with 500 tickets/mo, marked Most popular, with the button Start for free; Advanced $70/month with 14-Day Free Trial, All from Standard, Knowledge Base: Unlimited Articles, Unlimited FAQ translations, Premium templates and CRM with 1000 tickets/mo, with the button Start for free; Enterprise $120/month with All from Advanced, Knowledge Base: Unlimited Articles, Unlimited FAQ translations, Prioritized support, Overall & per agent performance report and CRM with 2000 tickets/mo, with the button Change plan; and a strip for the Free plan with No AI integrations, Limited FAQ articles, Default FAQ designs, Knowledge Base: Up to 10 Articles and the link Get started. The cards show no price per extra ticket. The store name with its small icon in the bottom left corner of the menu is hidden.

The Helpdesk tab of the app on the Free plan (a small image): the tabs Helpdesk, FAQ Page, Product Tabs, Contact Form, Widget and Pricing; My plan: Free with Tickets: 10 and a button Upgrade; a card Manage customer inquiries with helpdesk (live chat, emails, messengers, chat bots) with a button Create account (not used); the cards Ticketing, Tickets with Monthly ticket limit 0/10 (0%) and Top-ups are only available on paid plans., and My plan with Your current plan, Free, 10 Tickets, Tickets number resets on 17/12/2026 and a button Upgrade; and the start of a promo card about a live chat translation service. The store name with its small icon in the bottom left corner of the menu is hidden.

The FAQ Page tab of the app, the part Edit page: a switch Turn on all articles (off), the category Orders with the section Tracking holding three articles, How to track my order? (the example, switch off), How long does shipping take? (switch on) and What is your return policy? (switch on), both with Last update 17/11/2026, and below them the section Shipping and the category Exchange & Returns (both off) and the line Add new category. This shows two questions saved inside the app; it does not show a FAQ page in the web shop, which was not seen. The store name with its small icon in the bottom left corner of the menu is hidden.

The App embeds list of the theme editor for the live theme (test-data, Active, Home page) with the preview of the store on the right: for HelpCenter the four embeds Contact form, Live Chat, Tabs and Widget, all off except the Widget, which was switched on in an unsaved preview (the button Save was not used and the editor was left with Leave page); there is no embed for a FAQ page; further down embeds of other apps (Postscript, Essential Upsell, Post Purchase Upsell Hero, Kedra Checkout Rules, Rapid Search). The preview shows a Shopify sample store (Generated test data); the store name in the header of the preview is hidden.
